nodes.label: Viable genesis
nodes.title: No global scalar telos
nodes.summary: Viability and the ability to revise distinctions constrain the entire ecology.
nodes.detail: An architectural orientation, not a proved scalar objective or conscious organism.

nodes.label: Tissue / morphogenesis
nodes.summary: A synthetic mechanochemical model has priced growth, pruning and contact formation.
nodes.detail: G0-F measured finite-volume/tissue behavior under synthetic conditions, including failure modes. It is not experimentally validated neuron physiology.

nodes.label: Resources / clocks
nodes.summary: Positive resource accounting and distinct local clocks constrain adaptation.
nodes.detail: Mechanochemical and autonomic analogues use synthetic resource budgets; the signed neutral form is not physical energy.

nodes.label: Hypercomplex neurites
nodes.summary: Paid neurite sections add variable-rank quaternionic carriers.
nodes.detail: G0-AF makes each paid segment add a local quaternion section, with typed pruning remainder. Limited synthetic contracts; no learning advantage established.

nodes.label: Glia / tripartite support
nodes.summary: Glia-inspired local resource and tripartite contact modulation.
nodes.detail: G0-AG adds a synthetic support compartment. D0 short-horizon ablations yielded no clear developmental benefit.

nodes.label: Local Worldlets
nodes.summary: Different local representations carry different comparisons and boundaries.
nodes.detail: A typed local-context metaphor realized through multiple geometry and bundle experiments. Not one universal latent vector.

nodes.label: Trasgo / transport
nodes.summary: Frame-covariant comparison and explicit loss-aware correspondence.
nodes.detail: Conditional algebraic covariance and typed transport remainder are tested. No theorem that a transported representation retains every semantic distinction.

nodes.label: Neutral (2,2) carrier
nodes.summary: A signed matrix fiber with a neutral determinant quadratic form.
nodes.detail: The implemented Mat2(R) geometry retains non-positive and null directions. Its signed form is not a positive metabolic cost.

nodes.label: Holonomy / seams
nodes.summary: What survives transport around paths and nontrivial chart transitions?
nodes.detail: Finite connection/monodromy and nontrivial bundle contracts are tested, with explicit assumptions. The orbit graphic is an illustrative cue, not calculated holonomy.

nodes.label: Quaternionic sections
nodes.summary: Continuous unit-quaternion phases and ordered connection transport.
nodes.detail: G0-AG uses S3 phases and gauge-aware live learning/growth. The observation-to-quaternion map remains assumed and non-injective. No exclusive quaternion advantage measured.

nodes.label: Experience / sensorium
nodes.summary: Only locally available observations may modify the model.
nodes.detail: Synthetic event environments supply context and probe IDs; genuinely endogenous semantic context formation remains open.

nodes.label: Lullian interrogation
nodes.summary: Concordance, difference, contrariety and mediation generate hypotheses, not verified answers.
nodes.detail: G0-AD's typed question grammar inspires interventions. The historical Llull analogy is a generative tool, not an empirical claim.

nodes.label: Relational memory
nodes.summary: Witnesses, fading salience and context-conditional distinctions.
nodes.detail: G0-AD memory pools question modes in the current prototype; that can discard task-relevant information.

nodes.label: Question-indexed memory
nodes.summary: Keeping the interrogative mode improved a small synthetic forecast.
nodes.detail: Development D1a: ordinary question-conditioned Brier 0.208 vs pooled 0.243, at the same eight integer slots. Offline synthetic result, not a new implemented embodied organ or proof of general intelligence.

nodes.label: Provenance / remainders
nodes.summary: Remember what changed, what was lost, and which prior representation it came from.
nodes.detail: Typed round-trip and source continuity contracts are implemented. Not every historical record is yet chart-covariant.

nodes.label: Auditor / controls
nodes.summary: Negative controls, regeneration checks and correction history stay visible.
nodes.detail: Held-out and reproduction tests sometimes favor simpler baselines. Passing CI validates contracts, not the philosophy.

nodes.label: Unresolved remainder
nodes.summary: Relations not yet transportable should remain explicit, not silently flattened.
nodes.detail: Semantic source continuity, arbitrary context induction and physically grounded biological validity remain open bridges.

nodes.label: Local dendritic compartments
nodes.summary: Sixteen synthetic cells support up to four paid, genuine tree branches each; the ordinary cue-conditioned comparator scored better.
nodes.detail: G0-AH is a separate event-sourced operator reference, not the G0-AG CTMC. Question-and-cue-specific dendritic witnesses, delayed inhibitory/excitatory contacts, glia-gated slow consolidation and explicit ATP/material ledgers are implemented. Its first 14-seed task showed no prediction benefit: 0.185 Brier versus 0.177 for the simpler tabular estimator; glial consolidation and its ablation tied. The 3D chart is not brain anatomy.

nodes.label: Telos / role-free substrate
nodes.summary: A weakly differentiated synthetic tissue rewrites local plasticity mixtures and connectivity, but performs worse than its fixed recurrent control.
nodes.detail: G0-AI begins with 20 exchangeable role-free sites and local 3D contact constraints. Activity, slow novelty and resource cues change local rule mixtures and permit stochastic contact growth/pruning; no cell is preassigned a question or organ. The 12-seed noisy delayed-cue experiment measured Brier 0.2696 for the adaptive tissue and 0.2614 for the fixed same-dimensional reference. Contacts and rule variability did emerge; task competence did not. A conditional P1 sign-equivariance theorem explains a representation obstruction, not the entire finite result. The 3D film is a recorded synthetic process, not biological cognition or quantum computation.

findings.name: D0 / Developmental ablation
findings.label: No clear growth advantage
findings.unit: mean neurite extensions, full vs no geometry feedback
findings.footnote: 24 synthetic development seeds; zero connection repairs in every arm. Not held-out cognition.

findings.name: D1a / Interrogative memory
findings.label: Question identity mattered
findings.unit: Brier loss, conditioned vs pooled memory
findings.footnote: 14 synthetic development streams, eight bounded slots each. Ordinary memory did better; not an embodied result.

findings.name: AH / Compartmental neurites
findings.label: Ordinary estimator still wins
findings.unit: Brier loss, ordinary cue table vs G0-AH
findings.footnote: 14 synthetic development seeds; 16 somas, 64 paid branches. Glial consolidation tied its ablation. No biological or hypercomplex advantage.

findings.name: AI / Telos-nudged development
findings.label: Growth made prediction worse
findings.unit: Brier loss, fixed recurrent control vs growing rule-plastic tissue
findings.footnote: 12 development seeds. Morphology and rule mixture differentiated, but the fixed control did better; no biological, semantic or hypercomplex advantage established.
